raw_segments.text: Houses of decay, mine, his and all.
You told the Klangau's gentry you had an uncle a judge and an uncle a general in the army.
Come out of them, Stephen.
Beauty is not there, nor in the stagnant bay of Marsha's library where you read the fading
prophecies of Joachim Abba's.
For whom?
The hundred-headed rabble of the cathedral clothes.
A hater of his kind ran from them to the wood of madness, his mane foaming in the moon,
his eyeballs stars.
Howie Hinnom, horse-nostralled.
The oval equine faces, temple, buck mulligan, foxy Campbell, lantern jaws.
Abba's father, furious Dean, what a fence laid fire to their brains.
Path, descend, calve, utni, nimium de calvarys.
A garland of gray hair on his combinated head see him me clambering down to the footpaste
descend.
Clutching a monstrance, basiliskied.
Get down, baldpaul.
A choir gives back menace and echo, assisting about the altar's horns.
The snorted Latin of Jacpriests moving burly in their albs, taunchered and oiled and gelded,
fat with the fat of kidneys of wheat.
